# scaling_component (Data Source)

Looks up a component by name and exposes its id, so a configuration can reference a component created out-of-band without hardcoding the generated id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a component created out-of-band by name, for example to attach an
# inbound integration or report against it.
data "scaling_component" "checkout" {
  name = "checkout"
}

output "checkout_component_id" {
  value = data.scaling_component.checkout.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the component to look up. Must be unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `aliases` (Set of String) Alternate names inbound alerts match against to resolve this component.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description, or null if unset.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the matched component.
- `operational_status` (String) Current operational status (for example operational, degraded, major_outage, maintenance).
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns the component.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-update timestamp.
